blocks.html: Seeing that this traitor had robbed her of her honour, and of the reputation of her chastity, she forthwith brought the prisoner to Justice, and pursued him so vigorously that by judgment of the Judge of Rieux he was condemned to lose his head and to be put in four quarters; and, not content, after the appeal lodged by him to the Parlement of Toulouse, she presented a petition to the said Court, that she might be permitted to come there (for by the appeal she still remained under arrest [arreſtée: confined by the court's order]) to represent the outrage that had been done to her, and to pursue it,
